POLICE FORCE,
(DETECTIVE BRANCH)

18th September 1916.

Sir,
The office for the repatriation of rebels situated
at Vai Sung Jao 萬生橋 near the West Gate, is
conducted by two representatives of the Military Governor's
yamen Zau Lien Wong 趙聯芳 , the Chief Staff Officer
of the Military Governor, Brigadier General Zung Yau San
陳帮山 and the City Magistrate Shen Pao Chang 沈寶昌 .
Several merchants are also assisting. These are Chu Pao
San 朱葆三 Yu Ya Ching 虞洽卿 , Koo Shing Ih 顧馨一
Soo Yuen Zang 蘇錫尚 and Shen Lien Fong 沈聯芳 .
The Rebel leaders Wu Tsoong Sin 吳宗信 Pah Wen Wei 柏文尉
Chung Tsun Bang 龔振鵬 Tsen Da Pei 詹大悲 Han Hwe 韓恢
Tsang Wei Dau 張慰滔 Bang Yang Kwang 彭養光 and
Lee Tsung Oo 李徵五 form a committee of investigation
to whom applications are referred for enquiries as to
their genuineness.
The office is receiving the names of rebels who
desire assistance from the 13th of September to 6 p.m.
the 17th of September.
Attached is an official circular of regulations
governing the repatriation together with a translation
thereof.

Cop.
The time has now come for any
proclamation to be issued; but
please keep in close touch with
this movement, which if successful
will rid the Settlement neighbourhood
of a most undesirable class of
persons, quite a number of whom
Captain Superintendent of Police.

Your obedient servant,

Wm. Armstrong
Chief Detective Inspector.

all potential mischief makers. If the scheme is
not a success it will become necessary to bring the
matter to the notice of the Council in order that
other stringent action may be taken. With these dangerous
people here during the winter months there is no knowing
what may not happen & in any case the Police will be kept
exceptionally busy. Approved. C.O. 19/6.

警务处，

1916年9月18日。

先生：

位于西门附近萬生橋的叛乱分子遣返办事处，由督军公署的两名代表、督军参谋长赵联芳少将陈帮山以及上海县知事沈寶昌负责管理。另有数名商人协助工作，他们是朱葆三、虞洽卿、顧馨一、蘇錫尚和沈聯芳。叛乱首领吳宗信、柏文尉、龔振鵬、詹大悲、韓恢、張慰滔、彭養光和李徵五组成一个调查委员会，申请遣返者的材料将转交该委员会，以核查其真实性。

该办事处自9月13日起至9月17日下午6时止，接收希望获得援助的叛乱分子的名单。

随函附上关于遣返事宜的官方规章通告及其译文一份。

副本。
现在是发布任何公告的时候了；但请与此项行动保持密切联系，如果成功，将使租界周边地区摆脱一类极不受欢迎的人员，其中相当一部分人是潜在的滋事分子。如果该计划不成功，则有必要将此事项提请工部局注意，以便采取其他严厉措施。冬季期间这些危险人物滞留此地，后果难料，且无论如何警方都将异常忙碌。批准。C.O. 19/6。

您的顺从仆人，

Wm. Armstrong
首席侦探督察。

page_data.en:
in Wan Pao.
12-9-16.

Repatriation of Rebels.
.......................

The regulations governing the repatriation of rebels
in Shanghai have been adopted after careful consideration
by the Shanghai Military Governor, the gentry and the
rebel leaders and have met with the approval of the
Tuchun of Kiangsu, Feng Kuo Chang. The office for the
purpose was established on the premises of the Bureau of
Reclaimed Land at Vai Sung Jao 萬生橋 outside the
West Gate on the 11th September. The lists of names of
rebels which were sent to the Military Governor's yamen
will not be taken into consideration and the rebels in
Shanghai should send their names and careers for
investigation to the office above mentioned between the
13th of September and 6 p.m. on the 17th of September.
Those rebels who send in their names individually or
after the expiry of the time mentioned will not be accepted.
Those rebels who wish to make arrangements with the
Shanghai Military Governor re their repatriation should
call at the office. The following are the regulations
governing the repatriation:-
(1) The repatriation of rebels in Shanghai is carried
out by the representatives of the Military Governor's
yamen, the leaders of the various revolutionary parties
and the noted gentry and merchants in Shanghai.
(2) The office for the repatriation of rebels has been
established by the representatives of the Military
Governor's yamen on the premises of the Reclaimed Land
Bureau at Vai Sung Jao outside the West Gate.
(3) A Bureau of Investigation has been established in
the office for the repatriation of rebels.
(4) After the office for the repatriation of rebels
is established, the leaders of the various rebel parties
should forward lists of the names of their
followers within the dates mentioned.
(5) The money for the repatriation will be handed to
the rebel leaders for distribution amongst their followers.
Those rebel leaders who have suffered loss and are unable
to support themselves through their devotion to the
public cause, should send a clear account to the office
where they will receive monetary assistance and consideration.
(6) After the money for the repatriation issued, the
rebel leaders shall undertake the responsibility of
disbanding their followers.
(7) Those rebels who do not belong to any party shall
place themselves under the control of noted rebel leaders
and the latter will give them letters of introduction
with which they can come to the office.
(8) After the rebels are disbanded, the officials
of the provinces who undertake the work of repatriation
will send copies of the names and native places of rebels
who have been repatriated to the Authorities of provinces
to which they belong, so that protection will be rendered
to them.
(9) The rebel leaders shall send the names of rebels
who were military men, members of police, professors
and politicians to the officials who take charge of the
repatriation of rebels of the provinces concerned and
the latter will forward same to the Government for
employment. Those rebels who are in schools shall be
treated according to the order issued by the Government.

Regulations of the Bureau of investigation.
(1) The Bureau of investigation is established by
rebel leaders who have been appointed officers for
investigation by the representatives of the Military
Governor's yamen.
(2) The representatives of the Military Governor's
yamen who find anything suspicious in the lists of names
of rebels which have been sent to the office, will hand
them to the Bureau of investigation for enquiry.

载于《万报》。
1916年9月12日。

遣返叛乱分子。
.......................

上海遣返叛乱分子的规章，经上海镇守使、绅界及叛乱首领仔细审议后通过，并已获得江苏督军冯国璋的批准。办事处于9月11日在西门外萬生橋的垦务局旧址设立。此前报送至督军公署的叛乱分子名单将不予考虑，在上海的叛乱分子应于9月13日至9月17日下午6时之间，将其姓名及履历送交上述办事处接受调查。凡单独报送姓名或在上述期限届满后报送者，概不受理。

希望就遣返事宜与上海镇守使做出安排的叛乱分子，应前往该办事处接洽。以下是遣返规章：

(1) 上海叛乱分子的遣返工作，由督军公署代表、各革命党派首领以及上海著名绅商共同执行。
(2) 叛乱分子遣返办事处由督军公署代表设立于西门外萬生橋的垦务局旧址。
(3) 在叛乱分子遣返办事处内设立调查局。
(4) 叛乱分子遣返办事处成立后，各叛乱党派首领应在规定日期内提交其追随者的名单。
(5) 遣返经费将交给叛乱首领，由其分发给追随者。那些因投身公共事业而遭受损失、无法维持生计的叛乱首领，应向办事处提交清晰账目，他们将获得金钱援助和关照。
(6) 遣返经费发放后，叛乱首领应承担解散其追随者的责任。
(7) 不属于任何党派的叛乱分子，应置于著名叛乱首领的管理之下，后者将为他们出具介绍信，凭此信可前往办事处办理。
(8) 叛乱分子解散后，负责遣返工作的各省官员会将已遣返叛乱分子的姓名及籍贯副本发送至其所属省份的当局，以便为他们提供保护。
(9) 叛乱首领应将曾是军人、警察、教授和政治家的叛乱分子名单，发送给有关省份负责叛乱分子遣返工作的官员，后者将把名单转呈政府以供录用。在校学习的叛乱分子，将按照政府发布的命令进行处理。

调查局规章。
(1) 调查局由被督军公署代表任命为调查员的叛乱首领设立。
(2) 督军公署代表若在送至办事处的叛乱分子名单中发现任何可疑之处，将将其移交调查局进行查询。

page_data.en:
2
(3) (Copies of ways as to how investigation is to
be made are kept in the Bureau)
The duty of the Bureau of investigation is to
find out :- (1) Whether the applicants who has forwarded
his name is really a rebel. (2) Whether there is any
misrepresentation. (3) Whether there are any attempts
to obtain money by forwarding fictitious names. (4)
Whether among the applicants there are any using more than
one name with the object of obtaining more than the share
of one person. (5) Whether the rebel leaders who have
suffered loss through their devotion to the public
cause have any proof to verify the amount of money they
lost as shown on the account which they send in.
(4) The officers for investigation shall not make any
enquiries re the private affairs of rebels.
(5) Anything handed to the Bureau of investigation
will be considered valid if it is passed and signed by
the majority of the officers for investigation.

Regulations of the Office for the Repatriation
of Rebels.
(1) The office is called the "Office for the
repatriation of rebels in Shanghai.
(2) The office is established by the representatives
of the Military Governor's yamen, the noted gentry and
merchants in Shanghai and the rebel leaders.
(3) The representatives of the Military Governor's
yamen are the officers in charge of the office. With the
exception of the officers of the Bureau of investigation,
all other officers will be appointed by the officers in
charge.
(4) If the officers in charge find anything suspicious
in the lists of the names of rebels which have been sent
to the office, they will hand same to the Bureau of
investigation for enquiry.
(5) The office hours will be from 2 to 5 p.m.
page_data.zh:
2
(3) （调查方法之副本存于调查局内）
调查局的职责是查明：(1) 报送姓名的申请人是否确为叛乱分子。(2) 是否存在虚假陈述。(3) 是否存在通过报送虚构姓名以骗取钱财的行为。(4) 申请人中是否有人使用多个名字，旨在获取超过一人份额的利益。(5) 那些因投身公共事业而遭受损失的叛乱首领，是否有证据证明其在所提交账目中列出的损失金额。
(4) 调查员不得查询叛乱分子的私人事务。
(5) 任何移交调查局的事项，若经多数调查员通过并签字，即视为有效。

叛乱分子遣返办事处规章。
(1) 该办事处称为“上海叛乱分子遣返办事处”。
(2) 该办事处由督军公署代表、上海著名绅商及叛乱首领共同设立。
(3) 督军公署代表为办事处主管官员。除调查局官员外，所有其他官员均由主管官员任命。
(4) 若主管官员在送至办事处的叛乱分子名单中发现任何可疑之处，将将其移交调查局进行查询。
(5) 办公时间为下午2时至5时。

page_data.en:
Commercial News.
1928-16.
The lists containing the former careers of the rebels have been forwarded to General Yang through Mr. Yu Ya Ching for consideration. Despite repeated discussions between Li Wei Hu李蔚華 (representative of General Yang) Mr. Yu Ya Ching and rebel leaders Wei Wen Wei 柏文蔚 Tan Jen Fung 譚人鳳 and others, both parties have not reached any decision. It is said that after examining the lists of the rebels' careers, General Yang found that there are over 12,000 rebels who are now staying in Shanghai and that he is unable to secure a large enough sum of money to cope with the expenses for repatriation of them. He therefore proposed that other suitable steps be taken to appease them.

It is reported that the rebels leaders here have proposed to organise their men into two divisions of the army. The Board of Army Affairs will be asked to command these forces directly they are organised.

（批：I.O. / for Report）
page_data.zh:
《商业新闻》。
1928-16. [注：原文日期格式疑似有误或为OCR错误，依原文保留]

包含叛乱分子过往履历的名单已通过虞洽卿先生转交杨将军审阅。尽管杨将军的代表李蔚華、虞洽卿先生与叛乱首领柏文蔚、譚人鳳等人进行了反复讨论，但双方尚未达成任何决定。据悉，杨将军在审查叛乱分子履历名单后发现，目前滞留上海的叛乱分子超过12,000人，他无法筹集足够资金来支付遣返他们的费用。因此，他提议采取其他适当措施来安抚他们。

据报道，此地的叛乱首领提议将其部下编组为两个师。陆军部将被要求在部队组建完成后直接指挥这些力量。

（批注：I.O. / 供报告用）

page_data.en:

Tsun Hua Sin Pao.
10-9-16.
The steps for repatriation of rebels have been repeatedly discussed by the various officials, gentry and rebel leaders here. It is now learned that an office for the further welfare of the rebels has been established at the xxxxxx outside of the West Gate and that over twenty rules in dealing with the subject have been drawn up. The day before yesterday General Yang sent Tsu Lien Hwong, 赵连胪 his chief of staff officer, to forward the drafted rules to General Feng Kuo Chang, the Tuchun, and Civil Governor Tsi Yau Ling of this Province for approval. Mr. Tsu returned here from Nanking yesterday.
It is expected that the local authorities will promulgate the same in the local Chinese press shortly. Poi Wen Wei 柏文蔚 Han Hwei 韓恢 Wu Tsung Sin 吳忠信 Tsen Da Pie 詹大悲 Li Tsong Wu 李徵五 Chung Chong Ban 龔振 Tsang Lun Kia 張介 and Ban Yang Kwong 彭善光 have been selected as officers in examining the qualifications of the rebels. They will commence to attend their duties as soon as the rules have been promulgated by the officials. Regarding the funds for the purpose the Central Government will appropriate $50,000 in silver and $250,000 in internal bonds. In case these funds are not enough the local officials will request Mr. Yu Ya Ching and other prominent merchants as well as the Chambers of Commerce in the Settlement and at Nantao to give their subscriptions. It is presumed that the xxxxxx work for sending away the rebels will be completed during the next month. It is also reported that the officials pay great attention to those bad characters who attempt to pass themselves off as rebels, and those rebels, who attached themselves to the various small groups, will not be allowed to apply for repatriation unless their genuineness has been proved by the rebel leaders.
page_data.zh:
C-24
《中华新报》。
1916年9月10日。

此地的各位官员、绅界及叛乱首领已多次讨论遣返叛乱分子的步骤。现获悉，已在西门外的xxxxxx设立了一个旨在进一步改善叛乱分子福利的办事处，并制定了二十多条相关规则。前天，杨将军派遣其参谋长赵连胪将起草的规则送交督军冯国璋及本省民政长齐耀琳批准。赵先生昨日从南京返回此地。

预计地方当局不久将在本地中文报刊上公布这些规则。柏文蔚、韓恢、吳忠信、詹大悲、李徵五、龔振、張介和彭善光已被选为审查叛乱分子资格的官员。一旦官员公布规则，他们将立即开始履行职责。关于此项经费，中央政府将拨款白银50,000元及内国公债250,000元。如果这些资金不足，地方官员将请求虞洽卿先生及其他著名商人，以及租界和南市的商会提供捐款。据推测，遣送叛乱分子的xxxxxx工作将在下个月内完成。另据报道，官员们非常关注那些试图冒充叛乱分子的不良分子，而那些依附于各个小团体的叛乱分子，除非其身份得到叛乱首领的证明，否则不允许申请遣返。

page_data.en:
Translation of the regulations governing
the repatriation of rebels in Shanghai.
....................................

(1) The repatriation of rebels in Shanghai shall be carried
out by the representatives of the Military Governor's
yamen in conjunction with the leaders of the various noted
revolutionary parties and the noted gentry and merchants
in Shanghai.

(2) The office for the repatriation of rebels shall be
established by the representatives of the Military
Governor's yamen on the premises of the Old Reclaimed
Land Bureau at Vai Sung Jao 萬生橋 outside the West
Gate of the Shanghai City. (the regulations of the
office have been drawn up)

(3) A Board of Investigation shall be established in the
office for the repatriation of rebels. (the regulations
governing the Board have been drawn up).

(4) After the office for the repatriation of rebels is
established, a notice will be inserted in the newspapers,
giving the dates within which the leaders of the various
parties shall make out and send lists of the names of
their men to the office.

(5) The money for the repatriation will be handed to the
leaders of the various parties for distribution amongst
their men. The rebel leaders who have suffered loss
and are unable to support themselves because of their
devotion to the public cause, shall send clear accounts
to the office which will give them monetary assistance.

(6) After the money for repatriation is issued, the leaders
of the various parties shall undertake the responsibility
of disbanding their men.

(7) Those rebels who do not belong to any party shall place
themselves under the control of the leaders of the various
revolutionary parties, or they may come to the office
with letters of introduction from the noted rebel leaders.

(8) After the rebels are disbanded, the Authorities of the
provinces who undertake the work of repatriation will
send copies of their names to the Authorities of the
provinces to which they belong in order to secure their
protection.

(9) The leaders of the various parties shall send the names
of the rebels who were military men, members of Police
Forces, professors, and politicians or who have taken a
special course of education, to the Authorities who take
charge of the repatriation of rebels of the provinces
concerned to be forwarded to the Government for employment.
Those rebels who are in schools shall be treated in
accordance with the order issued by the Government.

Regulations of the Board of Investigation.

(1) The Board of Investigation is inaugurated by the rebel
leaders who have been appointed officers of investigation
by the representatives of the Military Governor's yamen.

(2) The representatives of the Military Governor's yamen who
find any doubtful names in the lists sent to the office
by the various parties, will hand the same to the Board
of investigation for enquiry.
page_data.zh:
上海遣返叛乱分子规章译文。
....................................

(1) 上海叛乱分子的遣返工作，应由督军衙门代表会同上海各著名革命党派领袖及著名绅商共同执行。

(2) 遣返叛乱分子办事处应由督军衙门代表设立于上海城西门外万生桥（Vai Sung Jao）旧垦务局旧址内。（该办事处章程已拟定）

(3) 遣返叛乱分子办事处内应设立调查委员会。（调查委员会章程已拟定）。

(4) 遣返叛乱分子办事处成立后，将在报纸上刊登通告，规定各党派领袖向其成员编制名单并报送至办事处的期限。

(5) 遣返经费将交给各党派领袖，由其分发给所属成员。那些因投身公共事业而遭受损失、无法维持生计的叛乱首领，应向办事处提交清晰账目，办事处将给予其金钱援助。

(6) 遣返经费发放后，各党派领袖应承担解散其部属的责任。

(7) 不属于任何党派的叛乱分子，应受各革命党派领袖的管辖，或持著名叛乱首领的介绍信前往办事处。

(8) 叛乱分子解散后，负责遣返工作的各省当局应将名单副本发送至其原籍省份当局，以确保他们得到保护。

(9) 各党派领袖应将曾为军人、警察部队成员、教授、政治家或受过专门教育的叛乱分子名单，送交有关省份负责叛乱分子遣返工作的当局，以便转呈政府录用。在校就读的叛乱分子，应按照政府发布的命令处理。

调查委员会章程。

(1) 调查委员会由经督军衙门代表任命为调查员的叛乱首领发起成立。

(2) 督军衙门代表若在各党派送至办事处的名单中发现可疑姓名，应将此类名单移交调查委员会进行查问。

(a) Whether the applicants are genuine rebels.

(c) Whether there are any fictitious names.
(d) Whether there are any applicants using more than

(e) Whether the rebel leaders who have lost money

any proof to support the accounts they send in.

(4) The officers of investigation shall not make any enquiry

(5) Any names handed to the Board of Investigation will be

Regulations governing the office
for the repatriation of rebels.

(1) The name of the office shall be "The Office for the
Repatriation of Rebels in Shanghai."

(2) The office is established by the representatives of the
Military Governor's yamen, the noted gentry and merchants
in Shanghai and the leaders of the various revolutionary
parties.

(3) The representatives of the Military Governor's yamen shall
be in charge of the office. With the exception of the

appointed by the officers in charge.

(4) In case the officers in charge find any names in the lists

which are doubtful, they will hand the same to the Board
of Investigation for enquiry.

(5) The office hours shall be from 2 to 5 p.m.
page_data.zh:
2
(3) （调查依据的副本已拟定并存于办事处以备查阅）
调查委员会的职责是查明：-
(a) 申请人是否为真正的叛乱分子。
(b) 是否存在虚假陈述。
(c) 是否存在虚构姓名。
(d) 是否有申请人使用多个姓名。
(e) 那些因投身公共事业而蒙受经济损失的叛乱首领，是否有证据支持其所提交的账目。

(4) 调查员不得查问叛乱分子的私人事务。

(5) 任何移交至调查委员会的姓名，若经多数通过并由全体调查员签署，即视为（原文不清）有效。

遣返叛乱分子办事处章程。

(1) 该办事处名称定为“上海遣返叛乱分子办事处”。

(2) 该办事处由督军衙门代表、上海著名绅商及各革命党派领袖共同设立。

(3) 督军衙门代表负责主管该办事处。除调查员外，所有其他职员均由主管官员任命。

(4) 若主管官员在各革命党派送至办事处的名单中发现可疑姓名，应将此类名单移交调查委员会进行查问。

(5) 办公时间为下午二时至五时。

page_data.en:
Explanation of the basis on which
investigation should be conducted.

Ques. On what basis would you enquire whether the men are members
of the revolutionary parties or not?

Ans. We would base our enquiries on whether they belong to any
party. If they do not belong to any party, we rely on
their introduction by the leaders of the revolutionary parties.

Ques. On what would you base your enquiries into the number of
persons whose names are sent in on lists?

Ans. The officers of the Board of Investigation shall affix their
signature to the names of those □□□ whom they know to be
rebels and undertake the responsibility of passing them as
genuine, while the names of those whom they do not know
shall be handed to the Authorities concerned for enquiries.

Ques. Which class of rebel leaders are permitted to send in accounts
of money they have lost in the public cause?

Ans. Those who are recognised by the Board of Investigation as
having established rebel offices in Shanghai and have raised
men for revolutionary purposes.

Ques. On what basis would you decide the amount of money the rebel
leaders have lost in the public cause?

Ans. We will base our decision on the length of time the rebel
office concerned has been in existence, the number of offices
and whether they have obtained any money from other sources.

Ques. How would you classify the rebels?

Ans. We would classify them in accordance with the positions they
had held in the Government service and what positions in
the revolutionary service.

Ques. How would you find out if the rebels have left Shanghai for
□□□□□□□□ their homes or other places after they have
received money?

Ans. After the rebels have received money, their leaders have
to send in lists of names of rebels who have left Shanghai
to the Authorities for investigation and the latter will
publish the lists in the newspapers.

Ques. In case the money required for repatriation exceeds what
the Government is prepared to pay, is there any way to
adjust the matter?

Ans. In case there is a difference between the amount required
and the amount which the Government is prepared to pay,
a proportion sufficient to send the rebels away will be
granted.

Ques. The above will be published, but in case any persons come
to the office to make enquiries, shall the regulations
be shown to them?

Ans. They will be published.

Ques. Is there any danger in the Authorities publishing reports
of the amount of money which they pay to the rebel leaders
for the purpose of sending away their men and for the money
they have lost?

Ans. Will be published separately.

调查依据说明。

问：你们依据什么来查问这些人是否属于革命党派成员？

答：我们将依据他们是否隶属于某个党派进行查问。如果他们不属于任何党派，我们则依赖革命党派领袖的介绍。

问：你们依据什么来查问名单上报送的人数？

答：调查委员会官员应在其确知为叛乱分子的姓名旁签名□□□，并承担担保其为真实身份的责任；而对于他们不认识的姓名，则移交给有关当局进行查问。

问：哪一类叛乱首领被允许提交其在公共事业中损失资金的账目？

答：那些被调查委员会认可在上海设立了叛乱机构并为革命目的招募人员的人。

问：你们依据什么来决定叛乱首领在公共事业中损失的金额？

答：我们将依据相关叛乱机构存在的时间长短、机构数量以及他们是否从其他来源获得过资金来决定。

问：你们如何对叛乱分子进行分类？

答：我们将依据他们在政府服务期间所担任的职位以及在革命服务期间所担任的职位进行分类。

问：你们如何查明叛乱分子在领取款项后是否已离开上海返回□□□□□□□□家乡或其他地方？

答：叛乱分子领取款项后，其领袖必须向当局提交已离开上海的叛乱分子名单以供调查，当局随后将在报纸上公布这些名单。

问：如果遣返所需资金超过政府准备支付的数额，有什么办法可以调整此事吗？

答：如果所需金额与政府准备支付的金额之间存在差额，将拨付足以送遣叛乱分子离开的相应比例款项。

问：上述内容将会公布，但如果有人来到办事处查询，是否向他们展示规章？

答：规章将会公布。

问：当局公布支付给叛乱首领用于遣散其部属及补偿其损失的资金数额报告，是否存在任何危险？

答：将单独公布。

Shanghai Municipal Council.

（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL COUNCIL POLICE FORCE）
POLICE FORCE,
(DETECTIVE BRANCH.)

September 16th 1918.

Sir,
As a scheme is now on foot in Shanghai for the repatriation of unemployed rebels who have been invited to send in their names, through their leaders to the office established for that purpose, and as the whole matter will be dealt with and completed within about two weeks from now, I beg to suggest that some kind of warning in the shape of a Council's proclamation be issued, notifying all the members of the rebel bands who are dwelling in the International Settlement that they ought to take advantage of the opportunity which is now offered them of getting away from Shanghai and that if they fail to do so and get into trouble the plea which they have put forth in the past of being a stranded rebel or a political refugee cannot henceforth be of any value at all.

Your Obedient Servant,

Wm Armstrong
Chief Detective Inspector.

Captain Superintendent of Police.

（批：COPY.
Before referring to
the Council I should like some
more information regarding the
scheme for repatriation &
who is likely to be in charge
of where the office are
located. As many details
as possible. & the attached
newspaper cutting taken account of.）

（批：Reprimanded:
This circular is
inappropriate & would
not after have been written
in official rules.
WM）

Sin Wan Pao.
12-9-18.

Repatriation of Rebels.
.......................

The regulations governing the repatriation of rebels
in Shanghai have been adopted after careful consideration
by the Shanghai Military Governor, the gentry and the
rebel leaders and have met with the approval of the
Tuchun of Kiangsu, Feng Kuo Chang. The office for the
purpose was established on the premises of the Bureau of
Reclaimed Land at Vai Sung Jao 萬生橋 outside the
West Gate on the 11th September. The lists of names of
rebels which were sent to the Military Governor's yamen
will not be taken into consideration and the rebels in
Shanghai should send their names and careers for
investigation to the office above mentioned between the
13th of September and 6 p.m. on the 17th of September.
Those rebels who send in their names individually or
after the expiry of the time mentioned will not be accepted.
Those rebels who wish to make arrangements with the
Shanghai Military Governor re their repatriation should
call at the office. The following are the regulations
governing the repatriation:-
(1) The repatriation of rebels in Shanghai is carried
out by the representatives of the Military Governor's
yamen, the leaders of the various revolutionary parties
and the noted gentry and merchants in Shanghai.
(2) The office for the repatriation of rebels has been
established by the representatives of the Military
Governor's yamen on the premises of the Reclaimed Land
Bureau at Vai Sung Jao outside the West Gate.
(3) A Bureau of Investigation has been established in
the office for the repatriation of rebels.
(4) After the office for the repatriation of rebels
is established, the leaders of the various rebel parties
should forward lists of the names of their
followers within the dates mentioned.
(5) The money for the repatriation will be handed to
the rebel leaders for distribution amongst their followers.
Those rebel leaders who have suffered loss and are unable
to support themselves through their devotion to the
public cause, should send a clear account to the office
where they will receive monetary assistance and consideration
(6) After the money for the repatriation issued, the
rebel leaders shall undertake the responsibility of
disbanding their followers.
(7) Those rebels who do not belong to any party shall
place themselves under the control of noted rebel leaders
and the latter will give them letters of introduction
with which they can come to the office.
(8) After the rebels are disbanded, the officials
of the provinces who undertake the work of repatriation
will send copies of the names and native places of rebels
who have been repatriated to the Authorities of provinces
to which they belong, so that protection will be rendered
to them.
(9) The rebel leaders shall send the names of rebels
who were military men, members of police, professors
and politicians to the officials who take charge of the
repatriation of rebels of the provinces concerned and
the latter will forward same to the Government for
employment. Those rebels who are in schools shall be
treated according to the order issued by the Government.

Regulations of the Bureau of investigation.
(1) The Bureau of investigation is established by
rebel leaders who have been appointed officers for
investigation by the representatives of the Military
Governor's yamen.
(2) The representatives of the Military Governor's
yamen who find anything suspicious in the lists of names
of rebels which have been sent to the office, will hand
them to the Bureau of investigation for enquiry.

《新闻报》。
1918年9月12日。

遣返叛乱分子。
.......................

上海遣返叛乱分子的规章，经上海护军使、绅界及叛乱首领慎重考虑后制定，并已获得江苏督军冯国璋的批准。办事处于9月11日在西门外万生桥（Vai Sung Jao）的垦务局旧址设立。此前发送至护军使衙门的叛乱分子名单将不予考虑，在上海的叛乱分子应于9月13日至9月17日下午6时之间，将其姓名及履历送至上述办事处接受审查。凡单独报送姓名或在上述期限届满后报送者，概不受理。希望就遣返事宜与上海护军使做出安排的叛乱分子，应前往该办事处接洽。遣返规章如下：
(1) 上海叛乱分子的遣返工作，由护军使衙门代表、各革命党派首领以及上海知名绅商共同执行。
(2) 叛乱分子遣返办事处由护军使衙门代表设立于西门外万生桥的垦务局旧址。
(3) 在叛乱分子遣返办事处内设立调查局。
(4) 叛乱分子遣返办事处成立后，各叛乱党派首领应在规定日期内呈报其部属名单。
(5) 遣返经费将交给叛乱首领，由其分发给部属。那些因投身公共事业而遭受损失、无法维持生计的叛乱首领，应向办事处提交清晰账目，以获得金钱援助和关照。
(6) 遣返经费发放后，叛乱首领应承担解散其部属的责任。
(7) 不属于任何党派的叛乱分子，应置于知名叛乱首领的管辖之下，由后者出具介绍信，凭信前往办事处。
(8) 叛乱分子解散后，负责遣返工作的各省官员应将已遣返叛乱分子的姓名及籍贯副本送交其所属省份当局，以便为其提供保护。
(9) 叛乱首领应将身为军人、警察、教授及政治人物的叛乱分子姓名，送交负责相关省份叛乱分子遣返工作的官员，后者将把这些名单转呈政府以供录用。在校就读的叛乱分子，将按照政府发布的命令处理。

调查局规章。
(1) 调查局由被护军使衙门代表任命为调查员的叛乱首领设立。
(2) 护军使衙门代表若在送至办事处的叛乱分子名单中发现任何可疑之处，将将其移交调查局进行查问。

(3) (Copies of ways as to how investigation is to
be made are kept in the Bureau)
The duty of the Bureau of investigation is to
find out :- (1) Whether the applicants who has forwarded
his name is really a rebel. (2) Whether there is any
misrepresentation. (3) Whether there are any attempts
to obtain money by forwarding fictitious names. (4)
Whether among the applicants there are any using more than
one name with the object of obtaining more than the share
of one person. (5) Whether the rebel leaders who have
suffered loss through their devotion to the public
cause have any proof to verify the amount of money they
lost as shown on the account which they send in.
(4) The officers for investigation shall not make any
enquiries re the private affairs of rebels.
(5) Anything handed to the Bureau of investigation
will be considered valid if it is passed and signed by
the majority of the officers for investigation.

Regulations of the Office for the Repatriation
of Rebels.
(1) The office is called the "□□□□" for the
repatriation of rebels in Shanghai.
(2) The office is established by the representatives
of the Military Governor's yamen, the noted gentry and
merchants in Shanghai and the rebel leaders.
(3) The representatives of the Military Governor's
yamen are the officers in charge of the office. With the
exception of the officers of the Bureau of investigation,
all other officers will be appointed by the officers in
charge.
(4) If the officers in charge find anything suspicious
in the lists of the names of rebels which have been sent
to the office, they will hand same to the Bureau of
investigation for enquiry.
(5) The office hours will be from 2 to 5 p.m.

2

(3) （调查方法之副本存于调查局内）
调查局的职责是查明：(1) 报送姓名的申请人是否确为叛乱分子。(2) 是否存在虚假陈述。(3) 是否存在通过报送虚构姓名以骗取钱财的行为。(4) 申请人中是否有人使用多个姓名，旨在获取超过一人份额的利益。(5) 那些因投身公共事业而遭受损失的叛乱首领，是否有证据证明其在所提交账目中列明的损失金额。
(4) 调查员不得查询叛乱分子的私人事务。
(5) 移交调查局的任何事项，若经多数调查员通过并签字，即视为有效。

叛乱分子遣返办事处规章。
(1) 该办事处称为“□□□□”，负责上海叛乱分子的遣返工作。
(2) 该办事处由护军使衙门代表、上海知名绅商及叛乱首领共同设立。
(3) 护军使衙门代表为办事处主管官员。除调查局官员外，所有其他官员均由主管官员任命。
(4) 若主管官员在送至办事处的叛乱分子名单中发现任何可疑之处，将将其移交调查局进行查问。
(5) 办公时间为下午2时至5时。
